_comment: One-shot forced tick — read by run-tick.ts `auto` on the NAS (which git-pulls main hourly). Fires ONCE inside [notBeforeUtc, expiresUtc) at the next IDLE hour (a scheduled tick wins its own hour); the done-stamp lives in the container's data/.tmp. To arm a new one: change `key` + the window + mode, commit. An expired file is inert — safe to leave in the repo. 2026-08-25: recover the lobbying feed off-schedule after the keyless-fallback fix (2736a666) — the forced FULL runs refresh-lobbying, which now pulls the LDA filings list anonymously when the NAS key is absent, so lobbying.json refreshes without waiting for the 23:00 UTC scheduled FULL. (It also re-runs the whole FULL; company-cache still needs the good-IP PC box and will fire the new dark-pipe alert.)
